examples.english: He can sleep in the car.

examples.arabic: اختي بلشت تجهز الاكل وانا نظفت السيارة
examples.english: My sister started preparing the food and I cleaned the car.
examples.transliteration: ukhti ballashat tujahhiz alakel wa ana naddaft alsayyara

examples.arabic: فكرت نروح بالسياره على الجبل نشم هوا نضيف ونشوف خضار حلو
examples.english: I thought we could go by car to the mountain to smell fresh air and see beautiful greenery.
examples.transliteration: Fakkart nruh bel sayyara 'al jabal nshemm hawa ndif w nshuf khdar helu.

examples.arabic: ايوا الجبل حلو كتير ومعنا سيارة
examples.english: Yes, the mountain is very nice and we have a car.
examples.transliteration: Aywa el jabal helu kteer w ma'ana sayyara.

examples.arabic: بروح عالشغل بالسيارة وبشتغل طول اليوم لما ما بكون بالجامعة، بس اليوم قدرت توفر 10 آلاف ليرة.
examples.english: I go to work by car and work all day when I'm not at university, but today she managed to save 10,000 Liras.
examples.transliteration: Brouh 3ash-shoghl bis-sayyara w-bashtaghil tool el-yom lamma ma bakoun bil-jam3a, bass el-yom ideret twaffir 10 alaf lira.

examples.arabic: امي اشترت لعبة سيارة صغيرة من السوق
examples.english: My mom bought a small toy car from the market.
examples.transliteration: Ommi ishtarat lu'bet sayyara saghira min es-souq.
